responsibility: This file implements gfortran’s integration with libcpp for source preprocessing. It stores preprocessor option state, initializes built-in macros for Fortran and OpenMP/OpenACC modes, handles include-path and dependency-generation behavior, drives token-to-text preprocessing output, and translates libcpp diagnostics and callbacks such as file changes, macro definitions, includes, pragmas, and working-directory markers into GCC/Fortran diagnostic and output streams.
same_name_distinction: Implements gfortran’s libcpp integration, including preprocessor state, built-in macro setup, callbacks, dependency emission, and token-stream/output handling. Unlike gcc/fortran/cpp.h, this file contains the operational preprocessing machinery.
